title: REQ · Anonymous player session creation with HMAC token cookie
summary: POST /api/v1/player/session issues random player ID and signed token cookie
description: Context: no player code exists. Desired behavior: a token package that signs and verifies tokens as base64url(playerID.issuedUnix).base64url(HMAC-SHA256) using the config secret, and a handler that creates a random 128-bit hex player ID and sets a cookie. Expected result: response JSON contains the player ID and the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/. Why: players need identity without accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Given POST /api/v1/player/session, when called, then status 201 and body contains a 32-char hex id
Given the response, when inspecting Set-Cookie, then HttpOnly, Secure and Path=/ are set with Max-Age from config ttl
Given two calls, when compared, then the player IDs differ
Given a token signed with the secret, when verified, then the player ID is returned
